message: You know how some languages sound.
Isolating languages can have their ears apart
While agglutinative can have them together
Languages with evidentiality aspect will have big eyes
Let the number of teeth reflect a number of phonemes
Let their angle reflect how many consonants can be in one cluster
Those with many declension cases will have a big moustache
Number of genders can reflect in a hairstyle
Tonal languages will get stripes on the tongue
Those with pitch accent get another kind of stripes
Explore that, and hear how all these languages sound.
...or at least how some front-end developer guy thinks that they sound
